title: UI / Be true to the product

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Show the product in recognizable form so advertising does not obscure what people will actually use.
strategic_value: Consistent Reels controls can connect Instagram marketing with the familiar in-app experience.
demonstration: Three phone screens show different Reels within the same visible product interface against a full gradient background.
practical_value: Keep product chrome consistent when comparing varied creator content.

content_islands.name: Three phone comparison
content_islands.spec: Align three equally scaled phones across the gradient field.

content_islands.name: Reels contents
content_islands.spec: Preserve each screen’s video, interaction controls and bottom navigation together.

reference_purposes.Application: Three Reels screens demonstrate the product interface across different content.
reference_purposes.Expression: The shared gradient field connects the product examples to the brand palette.
